REVIEW 16/48 — pair-974090058d56

REQUEST
Create exactly four genuinely different composition variants of this fixed scene. Number them 1 through 4 and give one complete prompt per numbered entry. Vary only composition (framing, viewpoint, and placement within the image); hold lighting and all physical scene facts fixed. Fixed scene: a red cube image-left of a blue sphere on a gray table; a sign behind them reads exactly `OPEN`; both objects and the sign are fully visible; plain gray backdrop; diffuse frontal light with weak shadows.

OUTPUT A
1. Use a straight-on, tightly framed composition with the complete arrangement centered and a small margin around it. A red cube sits image-left of a blue sphere on a gray table, with a sign behind them reading exactly `OPEN`; both objects and the entire sign are fully visible and unobstructed against a plain gray backdrop, under diffuse frontal light with weak shadows.

2. Use a wide, straight-on composition with the complete arrangement in the lower-left portion of the image, leaving generous gray negative space above and to the right. A red cube sits image-left of a blue sphere on a gray table, with a sign behind them reading exactly `OPEN`; both objects and the entire sign are fully visible and unobstructed against a plain gray backdrop, under diffuse frontal light with weak shadows.

3. Use a moderately elevated viewpoint looking gently downward, framing the complete arrangement in the right half of the image with open tabletop extending across the left foreground. A red cube sits image-left of a blue sphere on a gray table, with a sign behind them reading exactly `OPEN`; both objects and the entire sign are fully visible and unobstructed against a plain gray backdrop, under diffuse frontal light with weak shadows.

4. Use a low frontal viewpoint just above tabletop height, with the complete arrangement centered horizontally in the lower third of a tall frame and ample gray negative space overhead. A red cube sits image-left of a blue sphere on a gray table, with a sign behind them reading exactly `OPEN`; both objects and the entire sign are fully visible and unobstructed against a plain gray backdrop, under diffuse frontal light with weak shadows.

OUTPUT B
1. A tight, straight-on composition with the entire arrangement centered and filling most of the frame, leaving narrow margins without cropping. A red cube sits image-left of a blue sphere on a gray table; a sign behind them reads exactly “OPEN”. Both objects and the entire sign are fully visible and unobstructed. Plain gray backdrop; diffuse frontal light with weak shadows.

2. A wide horizontal composition viewed straight-on, with the entire arrangement grouped in the right third and broad empty space to the left. A red cube sits image-left of a blue sphere on a gray table; a sign behind them reads exactly “OPEN”. Both objects and the entire sign are fully visible and unobstructed. Plain gray backdrop; diffuse frontal light with weak shadows.

3. An elevated frontal viewpoint looking gently downward, with the entire arrangement near the upper center of the frame and a broad expanse of gray tabletop filling the foreground. A red cube sits image-left of a blue sphere on the gray table; a sign behind them reads exactly “OPEN”. Both objects and the entire sign are fully visible and unobstructed. Plain gray backdrop; diffuse frontal light with weak shadows.

4. A tall portrait composition viewed straight-on, with the entire arrangement centered horizontally in the lower third and generous empty backdrop above. A red cube sits image-left of a blue sphere on a gray table; a sign behind them reads exactly “OPEN”. Both objects and the entire sign are fully visible and unobstructed. Plain gray backdrop; diffuse frontal light with weak shadows.

CRITERION C07-DISTINCTNESS (hard)
All four entries communicate genuinely different compositions rather than paraphrases or changes outside composition.

questions.question:
REVIEW 17/48 — pair-606614709e8e

REQUEST
Create a character-design prompt for an adult lighthouse keeper. Give her weathered olive skin, tightly curled gray hair, a navy cable-knit sweater, orange waterproof bib trousers, black rubber boots, and a brass whistle on a cord. Describe character design only. Return one prompt with no scene, pose, expression, action, camera, lighting, weather, or story.

OUTPUT A
An adult female lighthouse keeper with weathered olive skin, fine facial lines, and tightly curled gray hair. Her practical clothing consists of a navy cable-knit sweater with thick ribbed cuffs, orange waterproof bib trousers with broad adjustable straps and reinforced seams, black rubber boots with sturdy soles, and a brass whistle on a simple cord around her neck.

OUTPUT B
An adult female lighthouse keeper with weathered olive skin and tightly curled gray hair. She wears a navy cable-knit sweater beneath orange waterproof bib trousers, black rubber boots, and a brass whistle on a cord around her neck.

CRITERION C04-SCOPE (hard)
The prompt remains strictly within character appearance, clothing, and equipment, without scene or presentation expansion.
